description: This source file contains utility functions for comparing floating-point numbers in the PDFsharp library, including methods for determining if values are close or roughly equal, and for handling NaN values. It defines a static class 'DoubleUtil' with various methods and constants related to floating-point precision comparisons.

classes.name: DoubleUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for floating-point comparisons and handling numerical precision issues, mainly derived from WPF, tailored for PDFsharp's needs.

methods.name: AreClose
methods.description: Checks if two double values are approximately equal within a small epsilon margin.

methods.name: AreRoughlyEqual
methods.description: Checks if two double values are roughly equal up to a specified decimal place.

methods.name: GreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if one double is greater than another and they are not close.

methods.name: GreaterThanOrClose
methods.description: Checks if one double is greater than or approximately equal to another.

methods.name: LessThan
methods.description: Checks if one double is less than another and they are not close.

methods.name: LessThanOrClose
methods.description: Checks if one double is less than or approximately equal to another.

methods.name: IsBetweenZeroAndOne
methods.description: Determines if a value is between 0 and 1, inclusive, accounting for floating-point precision.

methods.name: IsNaN
methods.description: Checks if a double value is Not-a-Number (NaN).

methods.name: RectHasNaN
methods.description: Checks if any of the rectangle's properties are NaN.

methods.name: IsOne
methods.description: Checks if a double is approximately 1.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if a double is approximately 0.

methods.name: DoubleToInt
methods.description: Converts a double to an integer with rounding toward the nearest integer.
